backend.description: Object storage backend for Mimir, Loki and Tempo. Required when Mimir, Loki or Tempo is enabled. No default. The objectStorage.validate helper fails the render while it is unset.

existingSecret.description: Fixed name. The Mimir, Loki and Tempo values reference this Secret from static values. Create the credentials Secret with this name.

azure.$comment: accountName is required only when Mimir, Loki or Tempo is enabled, and conflicts with localBlobStorage.enabled, as connectionString does. Tempo also rejects connectionString outside localBlobStorage. Both depend on sibling values, so those checks live in the objectStorage.validate helper instead.

connectionString.description: Full Azure Blob connection string, overriding the endpoint derived from accountName. It embeds the account key and travels in a ConfigMap rather than the credentials Secret, so it is for emulators and development endpoints, not a real storage account. Set localBlobStorage.enabled instead to have it computed for a local Azurite.

store.description: AWS S3 or an S3-compatible store. Required with backend s3. No default. The objectStorage.validate helper fails the render while it is unset.

defaultOrganization.description: The GrafanaOrganization that takes over Grafana's org 1 ("Main Org.") with datasources reading the tenant set in global.tenant.

defaultAlertmanagerConfig.description: The Alertmanager config Secret for the tenant set in global.tenant, rendered from files/alertmanager.

localBlobStorage.description: Azurite, the Azure Storage emulator, as the blob backend instead of a real storage account. Development only - see doc/LOCAL_DEV.md.
